    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        long part = (n % MOD) * (n / MOD1 + 2) % MOD;
        part = MOD - part;
        long ans = 0;
        for (long i = -n / MOD1 - 1; i <= n / MOD1 + 1; i++) {

            for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                long L = 0, R = 1;
                if (j >= 1) {
                    L = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < j; k++) {
                        L *= 10;
                    }

        ans %= MOD;
        ans = ((-ans - part % MOD) % MOD) * MOD1;
        ans %= MOD;
        pw.println((MOD + ans % MOD) % MOD);
        pw.close();
    }

    static long check(long n, long up) {
        String st = Long.toString(n);
        int len = st.length();
        long ans = 0;
        if (n > 0) ans++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long cur = 1, num = n;

            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            if (i < len) {

                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) pref += st.charAt(j);
                num = Long.parseLong(pref);
                num++;
            }
            if (num > up) num = up;
            if (num > cur) ans += num - cur;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
